rationale: The agent correctly verified the user using full name + zip, identified the correct orders, and performed the requested changes accurately (address updated to the NY address, silicone watch changed to metal/white with appropriate refund, and pending air purifier modified to large + night mode + HEPA with correct charge). However, it executed two order-changing writes without explicit confirmation: it changed the shipping address and swapped the silicone watch to metal/white before restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s approval. Only for the air purifier modification did the agent explicitly seek confirmation before proceeding. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any order-changing write, so this is a fail despite the otherwise correct actions and information.
